tracker_edge_consistency_resolution.finding: The prior v2 draft proposed epic qualifier issues. The live root contract says task issues cannot depend on epics; an epic qualifier would make the final vb-eirmk.11 prerequisite edge invalid.
tracker_edge_consistency_resolution.resolution: Create each full-phase qualification-only qualifier as an open task under epic vb-eirmk. Keep vb-eirmk.11 as a task and require vb-eirmk.11 depends_on the actual created qualifier task ID. This is task-to-task; root membership is hierarchy only.
tracker_edge_consistency_resolution.no_workaround: Do not substitute tracks edges or closure-only tracking for the required dependency.
tracker_edge_consistency_resolution.creation_status: No issue created and no tracker edge changed.
